answer: Make every agent prove sustained work before it can transact at full weight: identities start with tiny limits and grow only through attested jobs peers can audit. A sybil swarm bends like a willow in the wind, fast and flexible, but with no history it cannot pass the bar; each fake account is flat shale with nothing underneath, while a real agent's reputation is a velvet record, soft proof built over time through verified work. Cheap to create, costly to age: that asymmetry makes mass fakery uneconomical.
